rounds.text: Apollo Pipes currently trades at an extreme valuation of 467x P/E [E1], a multiple that is fundamentally disconnected from the company’s deteriorating financial performance. While the sector benchmark P/E sits at 25.21x, the company’s own valuation metrics are significantly inflated [E6], [E7]. This premium is increasingly difficult to justify given that compounded profit growth has collapsed by 83% over the trailing twelve months [E20], following a 3-year decline of 42% [E19] and a 5-year decline of 36% [E18]. Furthermore, sales growth has turned negative, contracting by 4% over the trailing twelve months [E16] and 1% over the last three years [E15]. The disconnect between market expectations and reality is highlighted by the fact that price growth currently exceeds profit growth by 99% [E57]. Conceded: the company is currently in a capex build-up phase with a 143.2% increase in CWIP [E40], and it has shown some recent positive momentum in sales [E64], [E67].
